bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$root"
printf 'APP_CHECKOUT_SHA='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'APP_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'GATEAPP_DIRTY_COUNT='; git status --porcelain | wc -l
printf 'GAYBBS_RUNNING='; docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1
printf 'GAYBBS_IMAGE='; docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1
printf 'GAYBBS_BUNDLE_SHA='; docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d ' ' -f1
printf 'USERBOT_ACTIVE='; systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service
printf 'USERBOT_ENABLED='; systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service
